crossRefs.note: yet for love’s sake I rather beg, being such a one as Paul, the aged, but also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.
For this cause I, Paul, am the prisoner of Christ Jesus on behalf of you Gentiles,
I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called,
for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
Therefore don’t be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner; but endure hardship for the Good News…
Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother, to the assembly of God which is at…
Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother,
Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ:
as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.
For we are God’s fellow workers. You are God’s farming, God’s building.
But I counted it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, fellow soldier, and your apostle and…
Yes, I beg you also, true partner, help these women, for they labored with me in the Good News with Clement also, and…
and Jesus who is called Justus. These are my only fellow workers for God’s Kingdom who are of the circumcision, men who…
and sent Timothy, our brother and God’s servant in the Good News of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort you…
